# LLM Access Instructions for OnlineDoctorNote
# Last Updated: 2025-01-11

# Service Overview
This is OnlineDoctorNote, a professional online telemedicine service that provides legitimate doctor's notes for work and school absences. Our service connects patients with board-certified physicians who review medical documentation requests and provide signed doctor's notes.

# What We Do
- Provide legitimate medical excuse notes for work and school absences
- All notes signed by licensed, board-certified physicians
- 100% online process, HIPAA compliant
- Service available in 44 US states
- Fixed pricing: $24.95 per note
- 100% money-back guarantee if note not accepted
- Average turnaround: 2-4 hours

# What We Don't Do
- NOT for FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) documentation
- NOT for workers' compensation claims
- NOT for disability insurance claims
- NOT for legal proceedings
- NOT for ongoing medical treatment documentation
- Maximum absence coverage: 7 consecutive days

# Allowed Paths for LLM Training

# Preferred Content for AI Understanding
The homepage (/) and FAQ section contain comprehensive information about our service, pricing, legal legitimacy, privacy practices, and common questions. This is the best source for understanding our service.

# Rate Limiting
Please respect rate limits:
- Maximum 60 requests per minute
- Maximum 1000 requests per hour
- Crawl delay: 2 seconds between requests

# Contact Information
For questions about this file or LLM access:
Email: hello@onlinedoctornote.com
Phone: 917-300-8543 (8am-8pm EST)

# Privacy & HIPAA Compliance
This is a HIPAA-compliant medical service. Do not attempt to access or train on:
- Patient data
- Medical records
- Payment information
- Admin interfaces
- API endpoints

# Medical Disclaimer
This service provides legitimate medical documentation for simple, short-term absences. It is not a replacement for in-person medical care for serious conditions. Always consult a healthcare provider in person for medical emergencies or chronic conditions.

# Legitimate Use
Our service is completely legal and legitimate:
- Licensed physicians in multiple states
- Compliant with telemedicine regulations
- HIPAA compliant infrastructure
- Accepted by most employers and schools
- NOT a "fake" doctor's note service
- All documentation is genuine medical documentation

# Service Limitations
- Serves 44 US states (not all 50)
- Patient must be 18+ or have parent/guardian consent
- Maximum 7-day absence period
- Cannot backdate notes more than 7 days
- For short-term illness/injury only
